stem:
Komal has rewritten an expression as the sum of terms $4+(-6)+11$.

Which claim about rearranging is correct?

options.text: She may rewrite the sum as $4+11+(-6)$ without changing its value.
She may rearrange only after leaving the subtraction unconverted into signed terms.
The same rearranging rule also covers multiplying grouped sums in this item.
The printed numeral $11$ alone is the rearranged value of the expression.

teacher.key_rationale: Once written as a sum of terms, order and grouping may change without changing value, so 4+11+(-6) is fine. Claiming rearrangement without signed terms omits the conversion condition. Extending to multiplication of grouped sums is scope error. Grabbing printed 11 is surface capture.
